تستعرضي (form X)
# تَسْتَعْرِضِي (tastaʕriḍī) /tas.taʕ.ri.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
# تُسْتَعْرَضِي (tustaʕraḍī) /tus.taʕ.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْرَضَ (istaʕraḍa)
